en-GB.title: Exit Strategies: Selling, Refinancing, or Holding
en-GB.summary: RED Level 2 lesson 039: Exit Strategies: Selling, Refinancing, or Holding.
en-GB.body: This localized RED Level 2 lesson develops practical competency in Exit Strategies: Selling, Refinancing, or Holding. It preserves the English lesson's central purpose: analyse how the decision interacts with financing, cash flow, equity, risk, taxes, legal structure, time horizon, management, and broader financial goals where applicable. Learners should test assumptions, consider downside scenarios, and verify jurisdiction-specific tax, lending, insurance, estate, employment, business, and legal rules with qualified local professionals. The lesson supports informed decision-making rather than recommending a particular property, financing method, or investment strategy.
